summary: The page displays theme inconsistency with a light surface card inside a dark theme shell, alongside alignment issues in the skeleton component.

issues.title: Inverted container theme
issues.description: The central chat viewport uses a light surface token rather than dark theme tokens.
issues.evidence: Main chat container is light off-white amidst dark header and alert surfaces.
issues.suggestion: Set the chat container background to the dark theme surface token.

issues.title: Avatar skeleton vertical misalignment
issues.description: Avatar skeleton is misaligned with the accompanying text skeleton lines.
issues.evidence: Circular avatar starts below the top edge of the first horizontal skeleton line.
issues.suggestion: Align the top of the avatar skeleton with the top text skeleton line.
